verified_facts.text: The resort is on Playa Bavaro in Punta Cana and is all-inclusive.
verified_facts.excerpt: The **Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort** located on Playa Bavaro is the favorite all-inclusive resort

verified_facts.text: The resort is presided over by the Plaza Colonial.
verified_facts.excerpt: Presided over by the Plaza Colonial, and its 12 restaurants

verified_facts.text: Royal Service includes personalized butler service, VIP areas throughout the resort, and private areas with Bali beds and concierge service on Playa Bavaro.
verified_facts.excerpt: Personalized butler service, VIP areas throughout the resort with unique details and even private areas with Bali beds and concierge service on Playa Bávaro.

verified_facts.text: Royal Service is designed for guests over the age of 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxury designed for guests over the age of 18 who want to enjoy greater comfort and unparalleled experiences.

verified_facts.text: Royal Service guests stay in luxury suites with an in-room Jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Accommodation in luxury suites with in-room Jacuzzi

verified_facts.text: Royal Service guests have a private pool overlooking the beach with a pool concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: with Royal Service you also have access to exclusive spaces, such as a pool overlooking Playa Bávaro with pool concierge

verified_facts.text: The Royal Service Lounge offers private check-in and check-out.
verified_facts.excerpt: Start the experience at the delightful Royal Service Lounge, where you can check-in and check-out in private

verified_facts.text: The Oriental Garden Spa is influenced by Asian cultures.
verified_facts.excerpt: In an authentic oasis of oriental tranquility, influenced by the most important Asian cultures, Oriental Garden Spa will transport you to a haven of calm and relaxation

verified_facts.text: The resort has a pool with 6 hydromassage areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: A spectacular pool with 6 hydromassage areas

verified_facts.text: Passion by Martin Berasategui is a restaurant by the Spanish chef.
verified_facts.excerpt: Passion by Martín Berasategui, by the well-known Spanish chef, winner of 8 Michelin stars

verified_facts.text: Royal Service guests have the exclusive Italian Palazzo Restaurant next to the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: New and exclusive Italian Palazzo Restaurant, next to the water, for Royal Service guests only

verified_facts.text: Evening entertainment includes musicals at the Olympus Theater and resident DJs at the Red Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the Olympus Theater we have musicals for a great evening out.

verified_facts.text: The Red Lounge has resident DJs.
verified_facts.excerpt: at the Red Lounge you can find a cutting-edge space where you can dance to golden oldies as well as to the latest sounds thanks to our resident DJs

verified_facts.text: The Kids Club is at no extra cost and includes an adventure park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Here our youngest guests can have fun at no extra cost. Thanks to the adventure park they can climb, jump and have fun

verified_facts.text: The Baby Zone welcomes babies over the age of 4 months.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids Club zone where we welcome babies over the age of 4 months

verified_facts.text: Adult activities include salsa, bachata and merengue classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Salsa, bachata and merengue classes

verified_facts.text: Themed workshops cover cocktails, sushi, cigars and candle making.
verified_facts.excerpt: Themed workshops: cocktail, sushi, cigars and candle making

verified_facts.text: Activities list includes Cocotal Golf Course & Country Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cocotal Golf Course & Country Club

verified_facts.text: The lobby has a view of the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: as you enter the lobby, which, unlike most resorts in the area, boasts a bountiful view of the ocean

verified_facts.text: The exterior is colonial-meets-tropical, with white pillars, Spanish tiles and cobblestone pathways leading to hidden gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: the exterior of Paradisus is a colonial-meets-tropical delight. Glimmering pool water reflects off lofty white pillars, Spanish tiles, and cobblestone pathways leading to hidden gardens

verified_facts.text: The hotel was built in 2010 and renovated in 2022.
verified_facts.excerpt: This wildly popular hotel was built back in 2010 with a less aesthetically pleasing look, but it underwent renovation in 2022

verified_facts.text: Suites are muted spaces in neutral tones with marble floors and wooden bed frames.
verified_facts.excerpt: The suites are muted spaces defined by neutral tones

verified_facts.text: The hotel is tucked behind a golf course, far from town.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is tucked behind a renowned golf course, miles away from civilization.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments emphasize shiatsu techniques, inspired by Southeast Asian spas, with a hot tub at the spa's entrance.
verified_facts.excerpt: The team of specialists emphasizes fluid shiatsu techniques over deep tissue rubs—treatments and decor seem to be inspired by Southeast Asian spas.
